about: P64 T1 sealed portrait set: 24 new English sentences written 28. 10. 2026 before the first P64 framing change (no competitor game, no run on these sentences). p64-01 to p64-19 = one sentence per genre of GENRES (src/play/genre/contract.ts), in that order; p64-20 to p64-24 = five more for the genres with the worst portrait fill in the T1 audit. genre = what the quick game's offline classifier picks today (classifyGenre(text, null).ranked[0].genre, no model call); the no-model draft (draftGameSpecWithMeta, seed 1) played the same genre when written. Opened once in T8 (holdout-opened.json); nothing is tuned on it.

sentences.text: A paperboy sprints down a rainy avenue at dawn, dodging barking dogs and open manholes
A stuntman climbs the scaffolding of a half-built skyscraper while loose bricks tumble down
A retired wrestler brawls with mutant raccoons in the parking lot of an abandoned cinema
A hot air balloon pilot steers over snowy peaks, dodging thunderclouds on the way to the summit festival
A volunteer firefighter douses grass fires spreading across a windy hillside farm
A space trucker fires at hungry barnacles clinging to the hull of her cargo ship
A grumpy wizard hurls fireballs at stone golems in a crumbling mountain pass
A circus strongman stacks wobbly crates as high as the tent roof without letting them topple
A shy penguin dances on a frozen lake to win over the whole colony
Two rival chefs duel with wooden spoons on a rooftop restaurant at sunset
A clumsy baby owl flaps between tall pine trees on its first night out of the nest
A sleepy bear catches falling honeycombs in a wooden bucket under a buzzing beehive
A gardener bonks cheeky gophers popping up between the cabbage rows
A lone shepherd defends the hilltop village from packs of hungry wolves through a long winter night
A grandma with a kitchen knife slices flying apples flung over the orchard fence by a prankster
A duckling crosses a busy highway full of trucks to reach the pond on the other side
A tiny knight grows his army by marching through magic gates on a long castle road
Drop glowing slime blobs into a glass tank so matching colors fuse into bigger blobs
A plump walrus shoves noisy seals off a shrinking ice floe in the arctic sea
A tortoise in a hurry crosses a four-lane freeway packed with honking buses
A wizard's apprentice combines matching potion bottles into stronger elixirs inside a cauldron
Two beetles bump each other off the edge of a mossy tree stump
A lumberjack chops pinecones launched into the air by a grumpy squirrel
A pizza chef drops each topping at the perfect moment onto a spinning pizza
